title: Oral Selinexor-Dexamethasone for Triple-Class Refractory Multiple Myeloma.
abstract: Selinexor, a selective inhibitor of nuclear export compound that blocks exportin 1 (XPO1) and forces nuclear accumulation and activation of tumor suppressor proteins, inhibits nuclear factor κB, and reduces oncoprotein messenger RNA translation, is a potential novel treatment for myeloma that is refractory to current therapeutic options.
journal: The New England journal of medicine
